text:
Sorry to hear the replacement didn't make it. Yes, you may be able to get another one.

**How it works**
- A replacement plant has its own new 30-day guarantee, counted from when the replacement was delivered. That's 90 days if you're a Leafy Plus member and the membership was active when the plant was ordered. It can be replaced once more if it fails within that window.
- Open "My Orders" and submit a claim within that window with at least **two photos**: one of the whole plant and one close-up.
- A Plant Care Specialist will review it within **2 business days**. You don't need to send the dead plant back.

**Things to know**
- The plant sent as this second replacement **has no guarantee**, so it can't be replaced again if it fails.
- The claim isn't covered if the plant was repotted into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days, if pests or pets caused the damage, or if there was deliberate neglect. A cold or heat transit hold that you waived is also excluded.
- If the replacement arrived damaged and you're within **48 hours** of delivery, report it as Damaged on Arrival instead, with photos of the plant and the box.
- If the 30-day (or 90-day) window has already passed, the policy doesn't cover another replacement. I can escalate to a Support Lead to see whether an exception is possible, but I can't promise one.

A Plant Care Specialist can also give free advice on what may have gone wrong, by chat (9am-5pm Mon-Fri) or email, so the next plant has a better chance. Do you know roughly when the replacement was delivered?
